info.title: Prelude
info.author: Nextendo Network
info.description: Switch between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.
info.details:
Prelude is a homebrew application for switching between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.

Nextendo mode configures the Atmosphere files and patches needed to connect supported games and services to Nextendo Network. Nintendo mode removes Prelude's changes and restores the console's normal Nintendo network configuration.

Prelude applies its changes through files and settings that Atmosphere reads at boot, making the process reversible. After selecting a network mode, the console reboots so the new configuration can take effect.

changelog:
v4.0.16

## Prelude v4.0.16

**Minecraft Dungeons II online now requires the game's 1.1.3.0 update.**

- Minecraft Dungeons II updated to 1.1.3.0, which replaced the game code the Nextendo hosting patch was built for, so the party leader could no longer host a session. The patch in `dungeons2-nextendo/` now targets 1.1.3.0, and the 1.1.1.0 patch has been removed.
- Nextendo now requires version **1.1.3.0**. Players still on 1.1.1.0 will be asked to update before going online.
- The patch works the same way as before: the party leader's game hosts the session, and players on other networks join through the Nextendo relay. It still includes the console fix for the host crash (2168-0002) when another player logs in.

What to do: update Minecraft Dungeons II to 1.1.3.0, update Prelude, open it once in Nextendo mode so the new patch is installed, then **fully power off and restart** the console.

Tested: signing in and hosting a match on 1.1.3.0 with the same patch in the Nextendo emulator. Not yet confirmed on a real console; please report if hosting fails there.

Everything from 4.0.15 is unchanged.

Full changelog: https://github.com/NextendoNetwork/Prelude-Nextendo/compare/v4.0.15...v4.0.16
